description: Create a promo code buyers type at checkout — percent off OR a fixed amount off (never both). Optionally scope it to one offer, cap total redemptions, or set an expiry. Discounts apply server-side before tax and can never take the charge below $0.50. Works on one-time and subscription offers (on a subscription the discount applies to the first payment). Deactivate with deactivate=true via the API when a promo ends.

amount_off_cents.description: Fixed discount in cents — use this OR percent_off

code.description: The code buyers type, e.g. LAUNCH20 (stored uppercase)

expires_at.description: ISO 8601 expiry; omit for no expiry

max_redemptions.description: Total uses allowed; omit for unlimited

offer_id.description: Limit to one offer; omit for all offers

percent_off.description: Percent discount — use this OR amount_off_cents

name: create_coupon
title: Create a coupon
